stories.title: Create Atom Feed Endpoint at /api/feed.xml for Blog Syndication
stories.description: Implement a standards-compliant Atom 1.0 feed endpoint that aggregates all published blog posts for RSS readers and feed aggregators, enabling blog content syndication and discovery across feed platforms.
acceptanceCriteria: /api/feed.xml returns valid Atom 1.0 XML conforming to RFC 4287 with feed root, entry children, and required link elements
Each blog post appears as <entry> with <title>, <author>, <published>, <updated>, <summary>, and <content:encoded> fields
Feed includes <link rel='self' href='/api/feed.xml'/> for autodiscovery and <link rel='alternate'/> pointing to blog homepage
technicalNotes: Create app/api/feed/xml/route.ts with GET handler that imports blog posts and generates Atom XML (~70 lines)
Create app/lib/feed-generator.ts with generateAtomFeed(posts: BlogPost[]): string function (~50 lines)
Test command: npm run build && curl http://localhost:3000/api/feed/xml | xmllint --format - | grep -E '<(entry|title|published)'

stories.title: Build JB News & Updates Homepage Widget with Live RSS Fetch
stories.description: Create a homepage widget that fetches and displays 3-5 curated news items from JB tourism and local news RSS sources, with graceful error handling and Suspense-based async loading.
acceptanceCriteria: Widget displays latest news items with headline, source attribution label, and publication date; loads from 2 configured RSS source URLs
Network errors trigger graceful fallback: displays cached content or static placeholder without breaking homepage render
Widget uses React Suspense boundary with fallback skeleton; total load time <3 seconds without blocking page interactivity
technicalNotes: Create app/lib/rss-client.ts with fetchRSSFeed(url: string): Promise<NewsItem[]> using xml2js (~50 lines)
Create app/components/HomepageNewsWidget.tsx as async component with Suspense + error boundary (~80 lines)
Test command: npm run dev && DevTools Network tab > Slow 4G > reload /guide to verify fallback renders <2s

stories.title: Add Article JSON-LD Schema and BreadcrumbList Markup to Blog Posts
stories.description: Implement Article and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD schemas on all blog post pages to improve Google knowledge graph indexing, rich results eligibility, and internal link crawlability.
acceptanceCriteria: Blog post pages include Article JSON-LD with @context='https://schema.org', @type='Article', headline, datePublished, dateModified, author.name, articleBody, and image fields
BreadcrumbList schema displays navigation path: Home > Blog > Category > Post Title with correctly formatted itemListElement array
Schema validates without errors in Google Rich Results Test (search.google.com/test/rich-results) for a live blog post
technicalNotes: Create app/lib/schemas/article.ts with generateArticleSchema(post: BlogPost, baseUrl: string): ArticleSchema function (~40 lines)
Update app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx to inject <script type='application/ld+json'> in metadata with dangerouslySetInnerHTML (~15 lines)
Test command: npm run build && npm run start && curl http://localhost:3000/blog/visa-run | jq '[.[] | select(.type == "application/ld+json")] | .[0]' 2>/dev/null | grep '@type'

stories.title: Extend sitemap.ts to Include Dynamic Blog Post URLs with Image Metadata
stories.description: Extend the dynamic sitemap generator to include all published blog post URLs and their featured images, improving blog discoverability in Google Image Search and enriching web search index coverage.
acceptanceCriteria: sitemap.xml includes /blog/[slug] URL entries for all published posts with <loc>, <lastmod> (ISO date), and <changefreq>monthly</changefreq>
Each blog post entry includes nested <image:image><image:loc> pointing to featured image URL and <image:title> with post headline
Unmodified posts default to lastmod=createdAt; updated posts use updatedAt field to signal freshness to search engines
technicalNotes: Update app/sitemap.ts to iterate blog posts collection and yield SitemapEntry objects with images: [{url: post.imageSrc}] property (~45 lines)
Verify each post object in app/lib/posts.ts has imageSrc, createdAt, and updatedAt fields defined
Test command: npm run build && curl http://localhost:3000/sitemap.xml | xmllint --format - | grep -A 3 'image:image' | head -15

stories.title: Expand /guide Page with Backpacker-Focused Sections and Internal Blog Cross-Links
stories.description: Enhance the /guide page with 6+ SEO-optimized sections covering transportation, budget dining, day trips, nightlife, safety, and JB attractions, each with 3-5 contextual internal links to blog posts and TouristAttraction schema markup.
acceptanceCriteria: Guide page includes 6 sections (Getting Around, Eating on a Budget, Day Trips, Nightlife, Safety Tips, Top Attractions) with 3-5 internal <Link> elements per section pointing to related blog posts
TouristAttraction schema JSON-LD includes 5 JB landmarks (Legoland Malaysia, City Square, Istana Bukit Serene, Marina Bay Waterfront, Taman Merdeka) with name, image, url, and geo.latitude/longitude
Page displays estimated reading time (e.g. '15 min read') and achieves Lighthouse SEO score >90
technicalNotes: Update app/guide/page.tsx to add 6 section components with GuideSectionProps interface; each renders 3-5 BlogLink elements (~130 lines)
Create app/lib/schemas/tourist-attraction.ts with generateTouristAttractionSchema(attractions: Attraction[]): ItemList schema (~35 lines)
Test command: npm run build && npm run start && npx lighthouse http://localhost:3000/guide --output=json | jq '.categories.seo.score'
